Reporting to the SVP, Accounting and Controller, this leader is responsible for overseeing Orgill’s accounts payable function across two distinct but interrelated entities—the hardware distribution operation and 140 retail stores. This leadership position will require the management of a large team, the oversight of ongoing accounts payable activities, the implementation of a new financial system and the optimization of processes and the A/P team to ensure timely and accurate payments, effective vendor relations, and compliance with internal controls.

title: Warehouse Associate - Pay Increase after 6 Months and 1 Year!
description:
What you will do:

When you become a material handler for Orgill, you will become a part of our exceptional team. As one of the key steps in our mission to help our customers be successful, you will be working throughout the facility to assist with the lifecycle of the hardline equipment and materials in our Post Falls, Idaho Distribution Center! You will be working alongside our tenured team to receive products, stock inventory, gather customer orders, or package / prep the products to be shipped. While you may not be working directly with the customers, without you, our customers cannot be successful.

title: Sr Developer Snowflake Data Platform (MDM)
description: We are seeking a motivated Mid-level Snowflake Developer to join our Master Data Management (MDM) team. You will play a pivotal role in architecting, optimizing, and securing our Snowflake environment to ensure a "single source of truth" for the organization’s data analytics and business intelligence initiatives. The ideal candidate brings a blend of technical expertise in cloud data warehousing, a disciplined approach to data governance, and the analytical mindset to translate business ambiguity into technical reality.
